verdict.rationale: Flagright markets its own in-product 'explainable AI agents' for AML operations and separately offers watchlist screening, so an agent with explainable output is plausibly first-party. However, nothing in the evidence ties the agents specifically to reviewing screening matches or recording a rationale per decision. Missing for 10: documentation showing agents reviewing screening/watchlist matches, evidence of persisted rationale or audit trail on match dispositions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
